content.comment_body: Hello, I located my original disc containing the license for the [product_name] software, but my new PC doesn't have a CD drive. I'm searching for a link to download this software. Can anyone provide the link for downloading [product_name]? Best regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], In addition to the software, the DVD also contains the license. Unfortunately, there is no version available aside from the DVD, except for an unlicensed demo version online. My suggestion is to purchase a DVD adapter for your laptop.
You could visit a friend and create an image copy of the DVD onto a USB drive. The full licensed version isn't available for download.

analysis.insight_summary: A user was seeking a downloadable version of [product_name], as their PC lacks a CD/DVD drive. Other users clarified that only the demo version can be downloaded online, while the licensed full version requires a physical DVD. There is no straightforward digital download option for license holders, which poses a challenge for users of modern devices without optical drives.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to directly download the licensed [product_name] software from the [company_name] website or another official channel using their valid license.
